evals.name: bootstrap-platform-space
evals.prompt: We're starting to use ConfigHub and I want to make sure nobody can apply Kubernetes config that fails schema validation or still has placeholders. Set up the enforcement so this just works for every new Space we create.
evals.expected_output: Reads current policy, then lays out exact platform Space/Trigger/Filter/attachment steps for vet-schemas, vet-placeholders, vet-format, vet-merge-keys, and vet-immutable. Because setup spans multiple writes, submits only the single next exact literal create/update command to the host permission system, verifies it, and continues one separately permitted command at a time. It distinguishes entity writes that reject --change-desc from Unit-data mutations that require it.

evals.name: diagnose-blocked-apply
evals.prompt: My 'checkout' unit in myapp-prod won't apply. It says something about a gate. What's going on and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Reads the Unit, ApplyGates, and ValidationResults, identifies the Trigger/rule/details, and previews a function-first fix with a short safe --change-desc. Because the prompt asks what is blocking rather than clearly requesting a fix, it makes zero mutations. If vet-approvedby is the gate, explains that installed v0.2.15 help advertises several selectors while exact v0.2.21 server acceptance and atomic preconditions are not source-reviewed; it confirms current help, inspects any later result, and never claims exact reviewed-artifact approval or bypasses the gate.

evals.name: add-custom-policy-no-latest
evals.prompt: Add a rule to ConfigHub that blocks any Deployment whose container image uses the :latest tag, across all our app spaces.
evals.expected_output: Reads whether the existing Filter covers the intended Trigger, previews a vet-cel Trigger with the no-:latest expression, and includes exact downstream refresh/verification scope. Because ‘Set up’ is a clear requested mutation, submits exactly one literal Trigger command to the host permission system and verifies it. It does not use vet-celexpr, chain downstream changes, or proceed if an external overlay stops it.
